title: Redesign v2 — art direction
blurb: Round 1e: three rebuilt directions, only ~50% tethered to A3/C2 — type scale + annotation instinct survive, the rest is new territory (color as surface, collage, structural split). Founders real; offerings = consulting · design · solutions.

variants.name: N1 · The Spectrum
variants.blurb: Color becomes the system: everything lives on a line between thinking (cyan) and shipping (magenta). Hero thesis in tinted lines, an interactive spectrum instrument, offerings as three tinted fields with positions (0.15 / 0.50 / 0.85), cases with spectrum locator dots, founders as the two ends of the line, full-gradient CTA.

variants.name: N2 · The Paste-up
variants.blurb: Studio-poster collage: 'AI that ships.' overlapping a giant gradient disc, rotated sticker labels, a manifesto with pasted highlight blocks, offerings as a fanned hand of cards, work as tilted 'receipts' with illustrative stamps, founders as two halves of one disc, CTA inside the 100-sun with an orbiting dashed ring. Violet→magenta.

variants.name: N3 · The Split
variants.blurb: The two real founders made structural: a THINK column and a SHIP column divided by one gradient seam running the entire page. 'Half strategy. Half software. One studio.' Consulting files left, solutions right, design sits ON the seam in a gradient-border card; cases alternate sides by who led; CTA = the seam widening into a full surface. Blue→magenta.
